fields.Name: AIUsageUnpricedAudit
fields.UserQuestion: Which completed AI runs have not been priced and need pricing tiers or investigation?
fields.Description: Surfaces completed AI prompt and agent runs where IsPriced = 0, along with diagnostic explanations for why each run was unpriced (unmeasured, missing model, or missing pricing tier).
fields.TechnicalDescription: Quality and audit query filtering [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts for IsCompleted = 1 AND IsPriced = 0, ordered descending by execution time. Emits UnpricedReason to assist administrators in backfilling model cost configurations.
